text: These don't dry my hands after washing up & aren't absorbent for spill cleaning. Good dust cloths in the car. One day I will learn to avoid dish towels that I have not actually handled in person. These are not the sort of dish towels that I need or want. I expect a kitchen towel to actually absorb water and be soft after going through the laundry. These are pretty and they look cute, but they do not dry your hands worth a flip. Nor do they soak up spilled liquids on the kitchen counters, which means that these towels are essentially useless for mess clean up. Honestly, I have relegated them to my truck as dust rags for the inside of it.
